description: This Java class 'EntityTypeUtil' provides utility methods for handling entity types, including checking type hierarchies, retrieving descendant types, and verifying parent types within the OFBiz framework.

classes.name: EntityTypeUtil
classes.description: Final utility class for entity type hierarchy operations in OFBiz.

methods.name: isType
methods.description: Checks if a collection of GenericValues contains a type related to the target type via a specified relation.

methods.name: getParentType
methods.description: Retrieves the parent type of a given GenericValue based on naming convention.

methods.name: getDescendantTypes
methods.description: Recursively retrieves all descendant types of a given type value.

methods.name: isType
methods.description: Determines if a type is a descendant of another type in the hierarchy.

methods.name: hasParentType
methods.description: Checks if a given type has a specified parent type, traversing the hierarchy via database queries.
